intro: Chang'e 4 landed in Von Kármán Crater on January 3, 2019 — the first soft landing on the far side of the Moon, where Earth is never visible. Communication was relayed via the Queqiao satellite parked at L2. Deployed Yutu-2 rover, which has driven 1.5+ km and is still operating in 2026, the longest-active lunar surface mission of all time. Found pristine mantle material in South Pole-Aitken basin.

Queqiao L2 relay satellite — without it, Chang'e 4 would have no contact with Earth. China built lunar comms infrastructure before going far-side.
